result:
Round 202 is implemented with no STOP. R93–R99 are applied, and the code review raised 4 Medium findings that I reported but did not fix. Each fix needs a change outside what the task lets me edit, so B has to rule on them. Nothing was committed or pushed.

**What changed**
- **Scope:** 31 granted files modified plus the 3 new files: `store-focus-ring.test.ts`, `sfx-video-choose-button.test.tsx` and doc 160 in Georgian. The frozen list still checks OK.
- **Scanner counts:** focus tokens went from store 155 in 31 files to 16 in 6, with studio unchanged at 13 in 5. Hidden focusables went from 6 sites to 5, and `ProductCard.tsx:132` now reads `reveal=True`. All match the expected numbers.
- **R96 cause, measured:** the home card `<Link>` was `display: inline` around a block, so the ring painted 0 pixels on every side. Adding `block rounded-xl` fixes it with no box change (320×417.6 before and after).
  - The first carousel card's left edge is still clipped by the carousel's `overflow-x`, which was already the case. The ring shows on the other 3 sides.
  - I tried the inset offset (R97) and rejected it, because the image then hides the ring's top side. R97 is used 0 times.

**Tests and checks**
- **New suites:** 15 tests, green on the tree. On a HEAD copy, STF2/3/4/6 and SV1/2/3/5 are red. STF1, the STF5 self-tests and SV4 stay green there, as expected.
- **Covering set:** 30 files, 357 tests, all green, and no frozen test went red.
- **Static checks:** `npm run typecheck` is clean, and `npm run lint` shows the same warnings as HEAD with 0 errors.
- **Mutants:** all 8 (m1–m8) turn their row red.

**Browser self-check (1280 only, partial)**
- Every element I checked gets the single 1px brass outline with no box-shadow ring: the search input, a Button, the ⌘K input, the card link, Play preview and the AudioPlayer sliders. Ring contrast is 3.35–5.66.
- Play preview now shows at opacity 1 on focus (0 at HEAD) and hides again when focus leaves.
- A mouse click sets `pointer` and shows no outline. In Studio the attribute keeps updating after navigating `/studio-lab` → `/` and back.
- **Choose video:** in the app it's BLOCKED, because `/scenes` needs sign-in. I mounted the real component on a live app page instead.
  - The ring paints, and Enter, Space and mouse all open the file chooser.
  - While busy, the chooser stays closed, and the button box matches the old label exactly.
  - One Space attempt at 1280 missed once; a rerun went 6/6, so C should repeat it.

**Medium findings for B (not fixed)**
- **Red error border on `Input`/`Textarea` never shows now.** The base `border-outline-strong` overrides `border-destructive` (confirmed in the browser), so it was already hidden when unfocused at HEAD. R94 removed `focus:border-destructive`, the only thing that showed it during focus.
  - This hits the sign-in, sign-up and forgot-password forms, which can't be checked in the cloud. C's error-border check uses other forms, so it will likely pass while this stays open.
- **Outline appears mid-typing.** After clicking a text field with the mouse, the first key pressed brings the outline back.
- **Clipped outlines.** In unpadded scroll panels in the scene builder the outline is cut off; this was already true before, and those pages can't be measured here.
- **Drag-and-drop lost.** Dropping a video file onto "Choose video" no longer works after R98.

I also tightened my own tests per two Low findings. The reviewer's architecture note is copied word for word into the report: keep the hook in root.

**Gaps in the task for B**
- The `/store` sort select can't be reached: the component that renders it isn't used by any route.
- With the mock, `/store` has no Play preview buttons, so I checked the preview overlay on `/` instead.

I haven't marked any C row as passed or any backlog item complete. Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; the report is `a-round-202.md`.
